queries_run: Fortinet product substitute technology threat 2026 SASE zero trust firewall disruption

findings.claim: FTNT 10-K 自述：替代技術的發展與市場接受度可能降低產品需求或使產品過時；競爭對手可能推出更便宜或效能更佳的產品。
findings.excerpt: The development and market acceptance of alternative technologies could decrease the demand for our products or render them obsolete. Our competitors may introduce products that are less costly, provide superior performance, are better marketed, or achieve greater market acceptance than our products.

findings.claim: Zacks：Fortinet 的 SASE Firewall 業務 2026 Q2 成長 34% 超過 $2B，競爭對手為 Palo Alto Networks 與 Zscaler。
findings.source: Zacks: Can Fortinet's SASE Momentum Propel the Stock to New Highs

note: 搜尋未找到具體取代 Fortinet 防火牆的單一替代技術證據；結果多為 SASE 競爭（Palo Alto、Zscaler、Cisco）的券商／Zacks 評論，未取得可逐字原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
